info.title: Mobilab Microservice
info.description: IH integration layer for the Mobilab External API. Every route mirrors the Mobilab path under /mobilab and is called with the IH JWT; the Mobilab API key stays on the server. To test here: run "IH login" (POST /v1/auth/login) once - the returned token is applied to every endpoint automatically, no need to use Authorize.

expires_at.description: Optional, must be in the future. Omit it to use Mobilab's default.

api_key.description: Key to revoke. Defaults to the configured MOBILAB_API_KEY.

CreateUser.description: At least one of email or phone_number is required.

assigned_to.description: Single phlebotomist; null/omitted = all active phlebotomists of the clinic

post.summary: IH login (Swagger helper) - gets the IH JWT
post.description: Forwards to the auth gateway POST /auth/login (AUTH_GATEWAY_URL). On success Swagger UI applies the returned token as the Bearer token for all other endpoints.

401.description: Invalid username or password

post.description:
Proxies Mobilab. Required Mobilab scope: none.

Omit `scopes` to get a key with ALL scopes. A key used as MOBILAB_API_KEY needs every scope, otherwise endpoints outside its scopes return 403 (e.g. /roles needs users:read, /clinics needs clinics:read). The issued key is NOT applied automatically - copy `api_key` into .env as MOBILAB_API_KEY and restart the service.
